messages:
maria (docs): Quick heads-up — noticed in /v1/generate the query param `response_type` enum in the API ref shows values `FULL`, `PARTIAL` but all examples use 'full' lowercase. This is causing confusion in SDK snippets and customer examples. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 :eyes:

ken (eng): Can you paste the exact curl example QA hit? If runtime actually enforces uppercase we need a compatibility patch.

maria (docs): Paste from QA: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","response_type":"full"}' 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```
Server returned 400 in their case. Docs currently show `FULL`.

docbot: deploy-bot: PR opened by maria — reviewers: lia, sam, ken — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421

lia (devex): I'll review. Also spotted another mismatch: the error response sample in the API ref uses `\{"message\": \"...\"\}` while the SDK error mapping expects `\{"error\": {\"message\": \"...\"}\}`. We should align or add a migration note.

sam (sdk): On the SDK side, python client currently assumes `error` wrapper: `resp['error']['message']`. This will break folks if docs and examples show the flat `message`. Two options: keep server returning `error` and update docs, or show both shapes in docs and make SDK tolerate both. Prefer tolerant SDK + docs note.

maria (docs): Proposal: canonical examples in API ref should use lowercase (`full`) because examples in most guides use lowercase. We'll update the OpenAPI examples and the code snippets to lowercase. Add a short migration note: "server accepts either `full` or `FULL`; examples use lowercase for readability". For error shape, include both variants in the example response and mark the flat `message` as deprecated. I pushed an update to the PR (commit 9c4f2b).

ken (eng): I'll run a quick compatibility check. If server is strict we should normalize incoming enum values server-side (case-insensitive parse) — will add a tiny normalizer and unit test. I can open a runtime PR and link it here.

lia (devex): LGTM overall. Two nits: 1) update the changelog entry under "Docs" with the PR link, 2) update the Go snippet where we currently set `ResponseType.FULL` (Go SDK uses enum consts) — add a short comment showing accepted string values.

docbot: ci-bot: docs-lint passed for PR 8421. link-check: failed — broken link at docs/sdk/python#generate-client referenced in the Python snippet.

sam (sdk): I'll update the Python snippet and add a guard in the client to accept both `full` and `FULL`. Current snippet: 
```python
client.generate(prompt="hi", response_type="full")
```
I'll add a comment: `# server accepts 'full' or 'FULL' — examples use lowercase`. Also will add a minor test in sdk/tests/test_response_type.py.

maria (docs): Updated PR with the lowercase canonical examples and an added "compatibility" note under the endpoint docs. Also added the dual-form error response example. Please check the new commit in PR 8421.

ken (eng): Runtime PR opened to normalize enums (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/558). Local tests pass. CI pending. This will accept case-insensitive values and normalize to lowercase internally.

lia (devex): Verified the updated Go snippet change. Left one nit about phrasing in the migration note.

sam (sdk): CI for the python SDK change green. Updated snippet link in docs so link-check should pass now. I also added a tiny compatibility test.

docbot: ci-bot: all checks green for docs PR 8421 after snippet fix.

maria (docs): Thanks everyone — merging once the runtime PR is green so examples match live behavior. Targeting merge in ~2h. Will add a tiny follow-up if ken's runtime change requires a minor note in the changelog. :tada:
